blocks.text: Experience a richer side of Brazil on a journey combining the vibrant spirit of Rio de Janeiro, the spectacular Iguazu Falls and the peaceful mountain landscapes of Visconde de Mauá. Discover Brazil’s coffee culture, lush nature and authentic local charm while enjoying a more relaxed and immersive Brazilian experience.
